acceptanceCriteria: CI responds to merge_group checks_requested and required go-product and doc-gates validate the exact group SHA; unsupported event-specific selection retains full-suite fallback.
Trusted ci-control-plane validates and reports on the exact group SHA without weakening existing CI-change approval policy.
Retain independent review and live evidence for a successful queue merge plus failed or stale group handling after explicit owner authorization.
Record enablement, queue timeout and concurrency choices, completion only after actual merge, evidence bindings and rollback to previous ruleset.
Plan against the exact merge_group base_sha..head_sha combined revision, including every predecessor represented in that group; never substitute individual PR diffs or current moving main.
Prove changed-package and dependency-interaction scenarios across multiple PRs with tests against the combined tree; qualify queue topology separately from the existing PR two-parent profile.
A queue rebuild, reordering, source drift or missing/unqualified selection evidence invalidates prior selections and runs the full relevant suite or blocks; mandatory checks remain required.
body: Observed 2026-09-30 via authenticated GitHub API reads of beamfall/corvint main. Public organization repository is eligible; main ruleset 23699808 requires go-product, ci-control-plane, doc-gates and allows merge commits, but has no merge_queue rule. Published ci.yml only triggers pull_request and push(main). Published ci-control-plane.yml accepts only workflow_run.event == pull_request and posts status on PR head SHA. Enabling a merge queue with these definitions would leave required checks missing on its combined SHA. This is a confirmed configuration capability gap; no live queue was enabled or exercised. Reproduction: gh api repos/beamfall/corvint/rules/branches/main and read the two published workflow files. Expected: all required checks validate each queue merge-group SHA while preserving trusted CI-change review. Related V1-0407 covers advisory ordering, not this compatibility prerequisite. Tool versions: gh 2.101.0; Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163; Tasks build 202. Official documentation: https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/configuring-branches-and-merges-in-your-repository/configuring-pull-request-merges/managing-a-merge-queue . Owner approval remains required for enablement and live merges. Owner clarified that the requirement is test adequacy over combined queued changes, not just queue admission. Source inspection: corvint affected --base joins the whole base..HEAD diff, but remains advisory with no proof that omitted tests are safe. tools/corvint-pr-tests/main.go:519-528 requires exact two-parent PR merge topology and runPR invokes that profile; no native merge-group qualification was observed. Queue-group support must bind the event base and group head, recompute reachability over the combined tree instead of unioning per-PR selections, and invalidate on queue rebuild. GitHub tests each group/prefix including predecessors, not every later queued PR. Continuation 2026-09-30: independent Gate A found no HIGH in the experimental full-suite group-audit plan. Focused baseline ToolIdentity/affected-package attribution and actionlint passed. Implementation claim twice refused RESOURCE_COLLISION against live attempt 5674ce910f771f06449c084109e406cc; no code changed and no owned attempt exists. Both native queue slots are occupied; admission must be retried after release without overriding other claims. Durable plan and checkpoint: /Users/russelllewis/projects/corvint/.git/worktrees/corvint1/corvint/merge-group-plan.md and merge-group-checkpoint.md. Isolated branch codex/merge-group-tests based on origin/main 5253b7e60d73eb70e7b4cb868bb8ac1c48b625d8 retained, enrolled dogfood key recorded in checkpoint.
title: ci: support required checks on GitHub merge group commits
